flagship.verification: 7,776 strict NO-CACHE LIVE games (15,552/15,552 preview.source=live, 0 belief mismatches, 0/15 cross-round seed overlaps) across 6-round full 32-shell PSRO closure (I1 Disclosed / Self-Consistent Shell equilibrium), centered on a uniform 96g/edge zero-leakage Elite-8 matrix (2,688g); plus 10,152g catalog refresh and 9,112g cf_party_ab local saturation audit
flagship.estimator: Bayes-Minimax (argmin_p E_{M~post}[max_i (M p)_i - 0.5], 0.5%-rounded 6-shell global optimum; dual_gap <= 0.012 pp)

condition.previewPolicy: SteppedCfPreview (CF-V_net v2 + Double-Oracle + LCB-gated Mixed Nash)
condition.battlePolicy: CfValuePuct (P_net PUCT + 144-dim Siamese CF-V_net v2 + 8r Hybrid Endgame Guard)

setOptimization.policy: training-v3: maximum HP/non-Attack stats and Hidden Power power; maximum usable Attack, otherwise minimum; preserve public gender, shiny status, Hidden Power type and camouflage

femalePreference.basis: female targets resist female sources and are susceptible to male sources; weighted direct-source-set mass is a proxy, not encounter or win probability

drawRule: each variant cluster among the 32 distinct shells is drawn with equal probability (1/32 = 0.03125), split equally among its members (s0053-lefties 2-variant cluster = 0.015625 each); drawWeight sums to 1.000000
